name: fips203-mlkem-esp32
description: ML-KEM (FIPS 203) post-quantum key encapsulation for ESP32. All three security levels (ML-KEM-512/768/1024). Ported from the mlkem-native reference implementation with hardware RNG support and a stack-lean configuration.
keywords: post-quantum, cryptography, key-encapsulation, kem, mlkem, kyber, fips203, pqc, lattice, mlkem512, mlkem768, mlkem1024
